sources.title: The Bitter Lesson of Machine Learning
sources.quote_checked: We have to learn the bitter lesson that building in how we think we think does not work in the long run. | We want AI agents that can discover like we can, not which contain what we have discovered. | The two methods that seem to scale arbitrarily in this way are search and learning.

sources.title: Richard Sutton – Father of RL thinks LLMs are a dead end
sources.quote_checked: Large language models are trying to get by without having a goal or a sense of better or worse. | You have to have goals or you're just a behaving system. | If you need to learn continually, continually means learning during the normal interaction with the world. | Learning then is from the stream, and learning is about the stream.

sources.title: Turing Award winner Rich Sutton founds Oak Lab to build AI agents that learn on their own
sources.quote_checked: weak and inefficient | need not more tweaks, but fundamentally new ideas and a thorough reworking | a trillion parameters that learns and plans in real time with 20 watts of energy

sources.title: Reinforcement Learning Pioneers Barto and Sutton to Receive the 2024 ACM A.M. Turing Award
sources.quote_checked: Barto and Sutton's work is not a steppingstone that we have now moved on from.

sources.title: Rich Sutton receives the 2024 ACM A.M. Turing Award
sources.by: University of Alberta, Department of Computing Science
sources.quote_checked: The 2024 Turing award is being awarded for laying the foundations to Reinforcement Learning.
